places.name: Colosseum
places.ai_summary: An iconic ancient amphitheater and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, known for its gladiatorial contests.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Book skip-the-line tickets to save time.
places.address: Piazza del Colosseo, Rome, Italy

places.name: Roman Forum
places.ai_summary: A sprawling archaeological site featuring the ruins of ancient government buildings and temples.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on uneven terrain.
places.address: Via della Salara Vecchia, Rome, Italy

places.name: Pantheon
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved ancient Roman temple, now a church, known for its massive dome and oculus.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major public holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds.
places.address: Piazza della Rotonda, Rome, Italy

attribution.author: Rabax63
attribution.description: Pantheon in Rome (Italy) - Front view with the Piazza della Rotonda and the Fontana della Rotonda in front of it.

places.name: Trevi Fountain
places.ai_summary: A stunning Baroque fountain famous for its grand design and the tradition of throwing coins.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late evening to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to throw a coin to ensure your return to Rome.
places.address: Piazza di Trevi, Rome, Italy

places.name: Vatican Museums
places.ai_summary: Home to an immense collection of art and historical artifacts, including the Sistine Chapel ceiling.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing. Closed on Sundays and certain holidays.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance to skip the long lines.
places.address: Viale Vaticano, 00165 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: St. Peter’s Basilica
places.ai_summary: An iconic symbol of Christianity and a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Dome climb requires a ticket and is subject to opening hours.

places.place_tip: Dress modestly as it is a religious site.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for the basilica, recommended for the dome climb
places.address: Piazza San Pietro, 00120 Città del Vaticano, Vatican City

attribution.description: Main facade of Saint Peter's Basilica, Rome

places.name: Sistine Chapel
places.ai_summary: Famous for its Renaissance art, especially the ceiling painted by Michelangelo.

opening_hours.notes: Access is only with a guided tour or as part of the Vatican Museums ticket.

places.place_tip: Maintain silence and respect the artwork.
places.address: Viale Vaticano, 00165 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Piazza Navona
places.ai_summary: A charming square known for its beautiful fountains, artists, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a gelato while strolling around the square.
places.address: Piazza Navona, 00186 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Spanish Steps
places.ai_summary: A monumental stairway of 135 steps, famous for its beautiful architecture and as a gathering place.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late evening.

places.place_tip: Climb to the top for a beautiful view of the piazza below.
places.address: Piazza di Spagna, 00187 Roma RM, Italy

attribution.author: Arnaud 25
attribution.description: Fontana della Barcaccia - Trinità dei Monti - Piazza di Spagna - Rome

places.name: Piazza Venezia
places.ai_summary: A bustling square dominated by the imposing Victor Emmanuel II Monument.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the outside at any time.

places.place_tip: Visit the monument for a panoramic view of the city.
places.address: Piazza Venezia, 00187 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Castel Sant’Angelo
places.ai_summary: A towering cylindrical building originally commissioned as a mausoleum, later used as a fortress and papal residence.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum and enjoy the view from the terrace.
places.address: Lungotevere Castello, 50, 00193 Roma RM, Italy

attribution.title: Castel Sant' Angelo Between Leaves
attribution.author: Lysandre Galiano

places.name: Campo de’ Fiori
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market square known for its fresh produce, flowers, and lively atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for the market atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies from the market stalls.
places.address: Campo de' Fiori, 00186 Roma RM, Italy

attribution.title: Campo dei Fiori
attribution.author: Myrabella
attribution.description: Piazza Campo dei Fiori, Rome: the market with the statue to Giordano Bruno in the background.

places.name: Villa Borghese Gardens
places.ai_summary: A large public park featuring gardens, lakes, and the Borghese Gallery.

opening_hours.notes: Borghese Gallery closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike or a boat to explore the gardens.
places.address: Piazzale Scipione Borghese, 00197 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Borghese Gallery
places.ai_summary: An art gallery housed in the Villa Borghese, featuring works by Caravaggio, Raphael, and Bernini.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is essential. Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings.
places.address: Piazzale Scipione Borghese, 00197 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Trastevere District
places.ai_summary: A charming neighborhood with narrow cobblestone streets, known for its nightlife and authentic Roman cuisine.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot. Visit the Santa Maria in Trastevere church.

places.place_tip: Try the local trattorias for authentic Roman dishes.
places.address: Trastevere, 00153 Roma RM, Italy

attribution.title: Santa Maria in Trastevere fountain
attribution.author: Jensens
attribution.description: Fountain at Piazza Santa Maria in Trastevere, Rome.

places.name: Palatine Hill
places.ai_summary: One of the seven hills of Rome, offering ancient ruins and a great view of the Roman Forum.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Colosseum and Roman Forum.
places.address: Via di San Gregorio, 30, 00186 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore
places.ai_summary: A major basilica known for its stunning mosaics and as a pilgrimage site.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass timings and special events.

places.place_tip: Admire the beautiful mosaics and the stunning ceiling.
places.address: Piazza di Santa Maria Maggiore, 00185 Roma RM, Italy

attribution.title: Basilica di Santa Maria Maggiore - Roma
attribution.author: NikonZ7II

places.name: Baths of Caracalla
places.ai_summary: Ancient Roman public baths, now in ruins, offering a glimpse into the city's imperial past.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 1 hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Imagine the grandeur of ancient Roman life.
places.address: Viale delle Terme di Caracalla, 00153 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Circus Maximus
places.ai_summary: An ancient Roman chariot racing stadium, now a public park.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Imagine the chariot races that once took place here.
places.address: Via del Circo Massimo, 00153 Roma RM, Italy

places.name: Piazza del Campidoglio
places.ai_summary: A historic square designed by Michelangelo, featuring the Capitoline Museums.

opening_hours.notes: Capitoline Museums closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museums for a deep dive into Roman history.
places.address: Piazza del Campidoglio, 00186 Roma RM, Italy
